query:
SELECT mt.id, ms.name as source_name, mp.name as product_name, mt.transformation_type 
FROM molecular_transformations mt 
LEFT JOIN molecules ms ON mt.source_molecule_id = ms.id 
LEFT JOIN molecules mp ON mt.product_molecule_id = mp.id 
ORDER BY mt.id LIMIT 20;
